partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Phenotype treatment plus causal-target inhibition
results.hypothesis: A drug can treat a disease when it treats one of the disease's phenotypes and independently inhibits a top-ranked causal gene.
results.body: drug treats disease phenotype from non-DRH/non-TTD source; drug binds and decreases top-three causal disease gene
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines symptomatic therapeutic evidence with an independent disease-directed molecular mechanism, but phenotype treatment may not modify the underlying disease.
results.trapi_notes: The phenotype-treatment, disease-phenotype, target, and causal-gene paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, rank, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[symptom_treatment:TREATS]->
      (phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE none(
    source IN coalesce(symptom_treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Specific-phenotype treatment plus causal-target inhibition
results.hypothesis: Phenotype-level therapeutic decomposition is more predictive when the treated phenotype occurs in no more than the graph p90 of 34 diseases.
results.body: R289 plus treated phenotype disease-member degree at most 34
results.mechanism_rationale: The disease-degree constraint reduces generic symptom transfer while preserving the independent causal-target arm.
results.trapi_notes: Same path expressibility as R289; phenotype-degree, source, rank, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
